gate.consequence: absences may be reported only as AUDITOR_DID_NOT_FIND_EVIDENCE; contested cells stand because a gate-passed quotation is verified against the transcript, not against the auditor

final_label_note: cross_model_outcome is the raw relation between the two codings; final_absence_label is what may be reported, after the global band and the subtheme eligibility rule. Under PROCEED_DETECTION_ONLY no cell may be labelled ABSENCE_CORROBORATED.

calibration_scores.interpretation: The detection rate on originally-present quote-verified cells is the only quantity scored against an external warrant, and it bounds how much this auditor can be trusted when it reports finding nothing. The concurrence rate on ORIGINAL_GEMINI_ABSENCE cells is NOT a specificity and NOT a ground-truth accuracy: those cells are the original coder's decisions, so a contested cell may be an original omission rather than an auditor error, which is the question the audit exists to ask and cannot assume away.

adjacent_confusion.limitation: the original coder's per-code quotations are not stored in any results artefact, so no direct comparison against its evidence is possible; these are signals from the auditor's own responses only
